correctness.rationale: For the main claim (R0 > 1), the printed reproduction number agrees with the frozen formula. Let b=(R0−1)c and D=cp+(lambda+c)M0>0. Then D(R1−1)=bp+(b−lambda)M0. This gives the iff for existence of a finite baseline, strict inequality beyond the unique crossing, and the nonattainment of 1 at finite baseline when lambda=b. The derivative is −R0*c*lambda*p/D² and the limit is R0*c/(c+lambda). Exact substitution of the publisher's Table 1 gives R0=7500/4001, M0,c=1698.1028207187…, R1(500)=1.3026792112… and lambda,c(500)=0.0239061895…. The checked threshold is local, as in Theorem 4.1. The aside at frozen RESULT.md line 96 should say 'at or below one' at zero baseline when R0≤1; at R0=1 and M0=0 it equals one, and any positive baseline gives strict inequality. That aside is outside the main R0>1 claim.
